$note: Extracted 6 Aug 2026 via pdftotext -layout, page-by-page direct read of the signed 2026 Sunworld/Serena contract (paginated PDF, not a flattened dump). NOT a Soroi property - Serena Hotels (Tourism Promotion Services Kenya Ltd / TPS Eastern Africa). This single 20-page contract document covers SEVEN Serena Kenya properties: Mara Serena Safari Lodge, Sweetwaters Serena Camp, Amboseli Serena Safari Lodge, Kilaguni Serena Safari Lodge, Lake Elmenteita Serena Camp, Serena Beach Resort & Spa (Mombasa), and Nairobi Serena Hotel. All extracted below in one file since they share one contract/rate card. Skipped from this folder: 'Serena Experiences Tariff Guide' PDFs (spa/excursion menu pricing, not accommodation), 'Serena Conference Package 2026.pdf' (MICE/conferencing, not relevant to leisure quotes), and the Tanzania-specific PDFs (out of scope - Kenya only per this extraction slice). Resident rate PDFs (KES, East Africa resident eligibility) captured separately below for reference only - out of scope for non-resident quoting.
operator: Serena Hotels (Tourism Promotion Services (Kenya) Limited, part of TPS Eastern Africa)
